# Formatting

Plain, *italic*, **bold**, ***both***, ~~struck~~, ==highlighted==, `code`, a [link](https://example.org) and <https://example.org/bare>. "Straight quotes" and 'single quotes' become typographic, as does the apostrophe in the Court's view. The 3rd edition and the 21st century.%%A comment that is never exported.%%

> A long quotation of three or more lines is indented, set a point smaller and takes no quotation marks, as AGLC4 requires. It runs on long enough to wrap across several lines in the export.[^1]

1. First numbered item
2. Second, with a nested list:
   - a bullet
   - another bullet
3. Third

- A bullet at the top level
- Another

| Case | Year |
| --- | --- |
| *Mabo* | 1992 |
| *Wik* | 1996 |

An inline footnote.^[*Wik Peoples v Queensland* (1996) 187 CLR 1.] A footnote referenced twice.[^2] Again.[^2] A multi-paragraph footnote.[^3]

---

After a rule.

[^1]: *Mabo v Queensland [No 2]* (1992) 175 CLR 1, 42 (Brennan J).
[^2]: *Native Title Act 1993* (Cth) s 223.
[^3]: First paragraph of the footnote.

    Second paragraph of the footnote, which "quotes" the Court's words.
